summary: RFC3339 parsing rejected date/time separators other than T or t, including spaces used by rusqlite. The fix consumes any single separator byte and reports a missing separator as InvalidComponent("separator"). This reversal restores the restrictive check in the OffsetDateTime parsing path. The existing parsing::rfc_3339 test gained space and dollar-sign cases in this commit; the space case should return InvalidLiteral with the reversal. No tests were executed.
